# ASC Pilot

> Find the money an App Store Connect account is leaking. Read-only CLI + MCP server for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Claude Desktop). By SpacePlant Corporation.

ASC Pilot scans every app in an App Store Connect account via Apple's official API and flags revenue leaks:
approved builds never released, live apps available in 0 storefronts, in-app purchases/subscriptions customers
cannot buy (Missing Metadata, Ready to Submit, Developer Action Needed), rejected versions blocking paywalls,
free apps with nothing to buy, stalled drafts, and (Pro) installs with zero paying users from Apple's Sales API.
Numbers come straight from Apple; it never estimates revenue or converts currencies. The user's API key never
leaves their machine.

## For agents: install and connect

- Install: `pipx install git+https://github.com/spaceplantcorporationofficial/ascpilot` (or `uvx --from git+https://github.com/spaceplantcorporationofficial/ascpilot ascpilot`)
- Credentials: `ascpilot setup` (interactive) or env vars `ASC_KEY_ID`, `ASC_ISSUER_ID`, `ASC_KEY_FILEPATH` (path to AuthKey_XXXX.p8), optional `ASC_VENDOR_NUMBER`
- Check: `ascpilot doctor`
- MCP (stdio): command `ascpilot`, args `["mcp"]`
  - Claude Code: `claude mcp add ascpilot -- ascpilot mcp`
  - Codex: `codex mcp add ascpilot -- ascpilot mcp`
  - Claude Desktop: one-click bundle `ascpilot-mcp-<version>.mcpb` from https://github.com/spaceplantcorporationofficial/ascpilot/releases/latest
  - Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.spaceplantcorporationofficial/ascpilot`
- All CLI commands accept `--json`.

## MCP tools

- `asc_list_apps` — every app: status, latest version per platform, IAP approved/total, territories
- `asc_review_radar` — approved-unreleased / rejected / in review / drafts / live
- `asc_revenue_leaks` — the leak scan (free: summary + worst leak; Pro: all leaks + fix playbooks). Start here.
- `asc_upgrade` — live pricing and checkout links
- `asc_sales_summary` (Pro) — installs, re-downloads, IAP units, paying units, proceeds per currency
- `asc_cashflow_report` (Pro) — full Markdown report

## Pricing and how to pay

- Free: $0
- Pro: $49 one-time (1 developer) · Studio: $149 one-time (whole company)
- Machine-readable plans + live Stripe checkout links: https://spaceplantcorporationofficial.github.io/ascpilot/pricing.json
- Or run `ascpilot upgrade --json`
- After payment the license key is shown on the thank-you page; activate with `ascpilot license activate <KEY>` or `ascpilot license claim <cs_... checkout session id>`.
- Agents: always get the user's explicit approval before opening a checkout or spending money.
